# generator-shortcuts

The strongest plausible canonical-fitting shortcut is **“use the canonical diagonal geometry, but hard-code the companion color as the other member of `{3,6}`”**: use 6 when the source is 3, otherwise use 3. Every labeled canonical source color is 3 or 6, so this rival reproduces all four canonical outputs while avoiding the intended `9 - source_color` relationship.

The exact counterexample is retained at `repo/generators/888fb4310749/counterexamples/fixed_36_color_shortcut.json`. It is emitted by the selected generator with seed `0`, sample index `0`, difficulty `easy`, and override `scene_profile="wide_block"`. Its source is a 2×5 rectangle of color 1 on a 14×10 canvas (input SHA-256 `e633450e898de9a1cd767a67aa7b32870440dd3f78c282d8395b19efce50622c`). The intended rule stamps the rotated companions in color 8 (`9 - 1`), producing SHA-256 `cdccfc5d1718ecb31f3a3a4b4761c15fab9dd47cf524d4642abf8d5e542611de`; the rival uses color 3 and produces SHA-256 `df675b53ce2dab132a0dfd05cf70e6d799dccd31f0dd56ec58ce3efcb270296e`.

I checked the canonical fit and disagreement in `test_fixed_36_color_shortcut_fits_canonical_but_generated_witness_refutes_it` inside `repo/generators/888fb4310749/tests/test_parametric_diagonal_mode.py`. The test verifies all canonical labeled pairs, regenerates the exact witness from its provenance, checks the selected `rule_mirror` output, and confirms the rival differs. The proposed generator does emit such cases: the fixed witness above is one, and the selected semantic census also declares and measures `non_36_source_color` against `fixed_3_6_complement`.


The repaired production curriculum was then checked against all declared rivals,
not just this one fixture. The final source-bound census materializes 100 ordered
lessons per difficulty band, with three demonstrations and one query per lesson,
and requires every possible query rotation to remain identifiable. Its retained
report is `checks/lesson-census-final-cf61.json.gz`; the fixed-seed period-2 start
enumeration is `checks/lesson-schedule-enumeration-final.json.gz`. These are finite
declared-rival checks, not a proof against every possible program.
